about_the_game:
Enter the fractured mind of a killer. Solve the mystery—or lose yourself in it.

Sinisomania is a psychological horror experience that blends visual novel storytelling with classic point-and-click gameplay. It begins with a haunting narrative that introduces a surreal world scarred by trauma and violence. But the story doesn’t end there—it drags you deeper.

When the game shifts, so does your reality. You awaken trapped inside the mind of a criminal, reliving fragments of a gruesome high school murder. You must navigate eight interconnected rooms, clicking through twisted memories, cryptic objects, and shifting environments to uncover what really happened.

Every choice matters. Every click reveals another piece of the truth—or another lie.

• 🏫 Mindscape Exploration: Switch between 8 unique rooms inside a corrupted high school setting—each one hiding clues, puzzles, and secrets.

• 🔍 Interactive Horror: Investigate eerie objects, uncover hidden triggers, and piece together the fractured narrative from inside a criminal psyche.

• 🩸 Psychological Tension: Unsettling visuals, sound design, and story elements blur the line between memory and madness.

Can you solve the murder before the mind consumes you?

content_descriptors.notes: The mature content is mostly horror and jump scare related.
